items.html: There is also a second Ibur of the Mochin immediately after the two years of Yenika, for the sake of the VAK of Gadlut; and there is a second Ibur after nine years and one day, for the sake of the GAR of Gadlut. And all of it is true. It will also be explained with this that the Mochin of the simple Elohim are the inner ones in the aspect of VAK, and afterwards the simple ones spread downward in the VAK of the body, and then the actual GAR of the Mochin of Yenika enter, and they are the aspect of Elohim in their fillings, as it seems to me.
